segment.description: Milan City Pond — the small city park pond in Milan, Gibson County, listed on TWRA's official trout stocking schedule as 'Milan City Pond' (Region 1). The project's curated anchor file (packages/content/data/west-tn-ponds.json) places it in Milan City Park, Milan (OSM-resolved anchor).
segment.boundaries: Entire pond. TWRA Region 1 winter put-and-take site; 2025-26 program stockings run through February and TWRA spring stocking begins March 1.

holdover.detail: No site-specific holdover evidence found. Program design is winter put-and-take: the 2025-26 winter program runs through February (spring stocking begins March 1), and the TWRA Trout Management Plan states hatchery-supported waters like these 'are primarily warmwater habitats that cannot support trout year round' and that 'survival of stocked trout is usually limited by summer water temperatures'.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout presence documented. The Trout Management Plan states wild trout are generally limited to East Tennessee's mountain streams; this is a warmwater West Tennessee city pond.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: Winter put-and-take only: TWRA's 2026 schedule lists 'Milan City Pond' (Gibson Co.) as a Region 1 Winter rainbow site (workbook rows 1/14/2026 and TBD 12/2026), the program ends in February, and the Trout Management Plan states such stocked warmwater habitats cannot support trout year round.
